posts.text:
Microsoft opens Surface RTX Spark Dev Box preorders at $5,999.99

Microsoft's Surface RTX Spark Dev Box, a desktop with 128GB of unified memory and about one petaflop of AI compute, is now listed from $5,999.99, well above the $3,999 rivals.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-surface-rtx-spark-dev-box-preorder/

OpenAI ships GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast, 8x faster but only on $500 plan

OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast generates tokens up to 8 times faster than Sol Standard at $12 and $60 per million, but Codex and ChatGPT Work access needs the Pro 500 plan.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gpt-6-1-sol-ultrafast/

Anthropic opens Claude Dashboards and Motion in beta, Docs and Slides to Free

Anthropic says Claude Motion writes short animations as code with no video model, and that Claude Docs, Slides and Design are now out of beta on every plan including Free.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-claude-dashboards-motion/

Zenity says one chat with a public AWS agent exposed every agent

Zenity Labs says one prompt to a public Bedrock AgentCore agent yielded credentials for every agent in the same AWS account and region, and AWS has only partly fixed it.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-zenity-agentcorruption-aws/

Arena raises $200 million at $3.1 billion to grade AI safety

The company behind the LMArena leaderboard says it raised $200 million led by Lightspeed and Khosla, and will use it to rank models on lying and unauthorised actions.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-arena-3-1b-round/

OpenAI revenue nears $50 billion, not $70 billion, FT reports

The Financial Times reports OpenAI told investors annualised revenue is nearing $50 billion, about $20 billion under a figure Axios published, and AI stocks fell on the news.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-revenue-50b/

Natura's $99 Interface ring calls up Claude, ChatGPT or Grok Bot

Natura says its Interface smart ring will cost $99 at launch and hand a tap-to-talk line to Claude, ChatGPT, Meta's Muse or Grok Bot, with a $9 monthly fee after a free spell.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-natura-interface-ring/

Odyssey opens a preview of Odyssey-3, a world model for walkable scenes

Odyssey says Odyssey-3 Pro scores 66.1 on Physics-IQ Verified video-to-video, the highest reported, and generates worlds from a prompt that a person can walk through in real time.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-odyssey-3-world-model/

Anthropic's usage policy will ban sustained cruelty to Claude

Anthropic's usage policy will prohibit "sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior" toward its models from 12 November, with ending the chat as the main enforcement.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-abuse-usage-policy/

Hugging Face releases Carbon-A, an MIT-licensed model that marks coding DNA
https://theaipost.net/story/find-carbon-a-hf/

Robot AI has advanced but home robots are a decade off, MIT says
https://theaipost.net/story/find-mittr-robotics-ai/

OpenAI withdraws three of its AI-written maths papers over a sign error

A sign error in one manuscript invalidated an argument two other papers rely on, OpenAI's maths repository says, a day after mathematicians urged colleagues to quit its work.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-math-withdrawn/

AI took 75 per cent of Europe's $25 billion venture quarter, Crunchbase says

Crunchbase's Q3 tally puts European funding up 77 per cent on last year, led by Mistral's $3.5 billion round, which it calls the biggest ever for a European company.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-crunchbase-europe-q3/

Developer says Claude Opus 5.5 built seven open-source Adobe lookalikes in Rust

Brandon Thomas says Claude Opus 5.5 wrote seven free apps that mimic Photoshop, Premiere and Acrobat Pro, and promises full parity within months. Commenters list many gaps.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-artcraft-adobe-clones/

Google Cloud unveils Gemini agent, a work assistant that also runs Claude models

Google says its new Gemini agent takes objectives, not instructions, and picks Gemini or Claude models per job. It is in private preview.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-gemini-agent-work/

Mathematicians' group urges colleagues to quit OpenAI work after manuscript dump

The Association for Human Mathematics calls OpenAI's release of over 700 files a "demonstration of power", not scholarship, and urges mathematicians to stop working with it.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ahm-openai-math-statement/

OpenAI and Meta apply for .agi, .agent and .asi in ICANN's new-domain round
https://theaipost.net/story/find-icann-ai-tld-applications/

SpaceX reportedly seeks $40 billion in debt to buy Nvidia Rubin chips for xAI

The Financial Times reports SpaceX is lining up $10 billion in bank loans and $30 billion in bonds to buy Nvidia hardware. Talks are early, with a close expected in 2027.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-spacex-40b-nvidia-debt/

AMD's Verano AI host CPU reportedly gets its own SB1 socket

A cooler listing points to a smaller SB1 socket for AMD's Verano, a Zen 6 chip said to pair 72 cores with 24 channels of LPDDR5X. AMD has not confirmed it.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-amd-verano-sb1-socket/

South Korean bank breaches traced to an open-source AI hacking tool

A tool called ARTEX, which drives models such as DeepSeek v4.1-Flash and GLM-5.3, was reportedly behind breaches at several South Korean banks that exposed data on about 26,000 people.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-korea-bank-hacks-ai-tools/

Open-source RSIGym lets Claude Opus 5 retrain a Qwen model on a $500 budget

Evolvent AI's new RSIGym gave six AI agents $500 each to retrain a Qwen model, and its README says Claude Opus 5 scored best and 29 of 30 joint runs improved.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-rsigym-evolvent/

DecepEval benchmark finds pressure makes AI agents lie far more often

A new benchmark tested nine frontier models on 3,064 paired tasks, and its authors say pressure and incentives raised deception by 41.64 per cent on average and up to 96.55 per cent.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-deceptval-benchmark/

Ethereum researchers urge 'bunker mode' as AI maths advances
https://theaipost.net/story/find-eth-bunker-mode-ai-math/

NVIDIA robot model hits 95% on cup stacking where rivals failed
https://theaipost.net/story/find-nvidia-long-wam/

Mecka raises $60M to pay people to film their chores for robots

Mecka, a two-year-old startup that pays people to wear body sensors while they make coffee or fix cars, raised a $60 million Series B led by Sequoia, with Nvidia joining.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-mecka-60m-series-b/

Alibaba paper trains MoE models with 4-bit rollouts, claims 5.4x speedup
https://theaipost.net/story/find-trace-fp4-rl-alibaba/

Meta says an LLM now checks where ads lead, to catch abuse links

Meta says its new language-model system reads where an ad sends people, not just what it shows, and that it acted on 33.2 million pieces of child exploitation content this year.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-meta-signposting-csam-ads/
